class.name: VoxelShapeData
class.brief_description: Sparse voxel occupancy, palette, rendering, and collision-feature data.
class.description: Stores an editable 3D grid as sparse 8 × 8 × 8 bricks. Palette index [code]0[/code] is empty and indices [code]1..255[/code] are solid. The resource can be shared by [VoxelVolume3D] rendering and [VoxelShape3D] collision. Coordinates are zero-based. Linear indices use [code]x + y * dimensions.x + z * dimensions.x * dimensions.y[/code]. Editing methods emit [signal voxels_changed] and increment the revision when a transaction is flushed. Surface feature classes and six-bit exposure masks are derived from occupied neighbors. Mask bits represent [code]+X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z[/code] in that order.

method.name: apply_voxel_edits
method.description: Applies coordinate/value pairs as one edit transaction and returns the number of changed cells. Array lengths must match; invalid coordinates are skipped.

method.name: apply_voxel_edits_by_index
method.description: Applies X-major linear index/value pairs as one transaction and returns the number of changed cells. Array lengths must match; invalid indices are skipped.

method.name: begin_edit
method.description: Begins or nests an edit transaction. Notifications are deferred until the matching outermost [method end_edit].

method.name: end_edit
method.description: Ends one edit-transaction level. The outermost call increments the revision and emits one combined dirty region if any cells changed.

method.name: fill_voxel_region
method.description: Fills an axis-aligned region, clipped to [member dimensions], and returns the number of changed cells. Negative size components are invalid.

method.name: get_corner_mask
method.description: Returns the six-bit exposure mask when the cell is classified as a corner, otherwise [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_corner_masks
method.description: Materializes a dense exposure-mask array for corner cells. This is a compatibility operation and allocates one byte per voxel.

method.name: get_corner_shape
method.description: Returns the collision proxy used for corner features.

method.name: get_corner_shape_scale
method.description: Returns the per-axis scale applied to corner proxies.

method.name: get_corner_voxels
method.description: Materializes a dense binary array whose corner cells contain [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_dimensions
method.description: Returns the voxel grid dimensions.

method.name: get_edge_mask
method.description: Returns the six-bit exposure mask when the cell is classified as an edge, otherwise [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_edge_masks
method.description: Materializes a dense exposure-mask array for edge cells.

method.name: get_edge_shape
method.description: Returns the collision proxy used for edge features.

method.name: get_edge_shape_scale
method.description: Returns the per-axis scale applied to edge proxies.

method.name: get_edge_voxels
method.description: Materializes a dense binary array whose edge cells contain [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_face_mask
method.description: Returns the six-bit exposure mask when the cell is classified as a face, otherwise [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_face_masks
method.description: Materializes a dense exposure-mask array for face cells.

method.name: get_face_shape
method.description: Returns the collision proxy used for face features.

method.name: get_face_shape_scale
method.description: Returns the per-axis scale applied to face proxies.

method.name: get_face_voxels
method.description: Materializes a dense binary array whose face cells contain [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_last_dirty_position
method.description: Returns the minimum coordinate of the most recently accumulated dirty region.

method.name: get_last_dirty_size
method.description: Returns the size of the most recently accumulated dirty region.

method.name: get_material_texture
method.description: Returns the 256-entry roughness, metallic, and emission lookup texture.

method.name: get_metallic_texture
method.description: Returns the 256-entry inverted metallic lookup texture.

method.name: get_transparency_texture
method.description: Returns the 256-entry inverted transparency lookup texture.

method.name: get_specularity_texture
method.description: Returns the 256-entry inverted specularity lookup texture.

method.name: get_emission_texture
method.description: Returns the 256-entry inverted emission lookup texture.

method.name: get_palette_texture
method.description: Returns the 256-entry voxel color lookup texture.

method.name: get_revision
method.description: Returns the monotonically increasing voxel edit revision.

method.name: get_solid_voxels
method.description: Returns a dense binary occupancy array. This allocates one byte per voxel; prefer point queries or sparse serialization in performance-sensitive code.

method.name: get_sparse_brick_data
method.description: Serializes the sparse 8³ brick representation.

method.name: get_voxel
method.description: Returns the palette index at [param position]. Out-of-range positions read as empty.

method.name: get_voxel_data
method.description: Exports one palette byte per voxel in X-major order. This dense compatibility API may allocate a large array.

method.name: get_voxel_index
method.description: Returns the X-major linear index for a valid coordinate, or reports an error and returns [code]-1[/code] if outside the grid.

method.name: get_voxel_size
method.description: Returns the edge length of one voxel in Godot units.

method.name: is_corner
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a solid cell has at least three exposed axis-aligned sides.

method.name: is_edge
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a solid cell has exactly two exposed axis-aligned sides.

method.name: is_face
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a solid cell has exactly one exposed axis-aligned side.

method.name: is_inside
method.description: Returns whether every component of [param position] is at least zero and less than the corresponding [member dimensions] component.

method.name: is_solid
method.description: Returns whether the palette index at [param position] is nonzero.

method.name: set_corner_masks
method.description: Validates legacy dense corner-mask data. Topology is derived and this setter does not replace it.

method.name: set_corner_shape
method.description: Sets the collision proxy used for derived corner features.

method.name: set_corner_shape_scale
method.description: Sets the positive per-axis scale applied to corner proxies.

method.name: set_corner_voxels
method.description: Validates legacy dense corner data. Derived topology is not replaced.

method.name: set_dimensions
method.description: Sets positive grid dimensions. Changing dimensions clears all voxel contents and marks the complete new grid dirty.

method.name: set_edge_masks
method.description: Validates legacy dense edge-mask data. Topology is derived and this setter does not replace it.

method.name: set_edge_shape
method.description: Sets the collision proxy used for derived edge features.

method.name: set_edge_shape_scale
method.description: Sets the positive per-axis scale applied to edge proxies.

method.name: set_edge_voxels
method.description: Validates legacy dense edge data. Derived topology is not replaced.

method.name: set_face_masks
method.description: Validates legacy dense face-mask data. Topology is derived and this setter does not replace it.

method.name: set_face_shape
method.description: Sets the collision proxy used for derived face features.

method.name: set_face_shape_scale
method.description: Sets the positive per-axis scale applied to face proxies.

method.name: set_face_voxels
method.description: Validates legacy dense face data. Derived topology is not replaced.

method.name: set_material_texture
method.description: Sets the 256-entry material lookup. Red is roughness, green is metallic, and blue is emission strength.

method.name: set_metallic_texture
method.description: Sets the 256-entry metallic lookup. White is 0 and black is 1.

method.name: set_transparency_texture
method.description: Sets the 256-entry transparency lookup. White is opaque (0) and black is fully transparent (1).

method.name: set_specularity_texture
method.description: Sets the 256-entry specularity lookup. White is 0 and black is 1; roughness is the inverse of the resulting specularity.

method.name: set_emission_texture
method.description: Sets the 256-entry emission lookup. White is 0 and black is 1.

method.name: set_palette_texture
method.description: Sets the 256-entry color lookup texture addressed by voxel palette index.

method.name: set_solid_voxels
method.description: Imports dense binary occupancy while preserving existing nonzero palette values. New occupied cells receive palette index [code]1[/code].

method.name: set_sparse_brick_data
method.description: Deserializes sparse brick data for the current dimensions. An empty array clears the volume.

method.name: set_voxel
method.description: Writes one palette index and returns [code]true[/code] if it changed. Coordinates must be valid and the value must be in [code]0..255[/code].

method.name: set_voxel_data
method.description: Imports exactly one palette byte per voxel in X-major order and rebuilds sparse storage.

method.name: set_voxel_size
method.description: Sets the positive edge length of each voxel and notifies rendering and collision listeners.

signal.name: voxels_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a voxel edit transaction is flushed. [param position] and [param size] describe the combined dirty region, and [param revision] is the new monotonically increasing revision.
